run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T09:39:09Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is the visible symptom of product-catalog being completely unavailable. At 2026-11-16T09:37:18Z the otel-demo/product-catalog Deployment rolled out a new ReplicaSet (product-catalog-fcf7564cf) whose pod template overrides the container command to ["invalid-command"]; the container cannot start (StartError, exit 128, 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'), sits in CrashLoopBackOff with 5 restarts and is never Ready. The previous healthy ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc was scaled to 0 and its pod deleted at 09:37:27Z, leaving the product-catalog Service with zero ready endpoints. product-catalog server spans stop (rate ~8/s to 0 between 09:37:09Z and 09:39:09Z) and frontend client spans to grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct begin failing; frontend error-span rate goes from 0 to ~5/s at 09:39:09Z and 16-21/s afterwards, which is when the alert fired (09:39:09Z). The same product-catalog calls fail from recommendation (ListProducts) and checkout (GetProduct), and frontend-proxy ingress spans record errors, so the failure is not confined to a single frontend route. The product-catalog failure is a container-command misconfiguration, not an image change (image digest path ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog is unchanged between the two ReplicaSets).

claims.text: Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog has spec.replicas 1, status.unavailableReplicas 1, and condition Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 2026-11-16T09:37:35Z; its pod template container command is ["invalid-command"] with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog.

Two ReplicaSets belong to Deployment product-catalog: product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 2026-11-16T09:07:17Z, replicas 0, no command override) and product-catalog-fcf7564cf (created 2026-11-16T09:37:18Z, replicas 1, command ["invalid-command"]), both with the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l is Running but not Ready (ready=false, restartCount 5, waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff); its last termination is reason StartError, exitCode 128, message 'failed to create containerd task: ... OCI runtime create failed: runc create failed: ... exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH', finishedAt 2026-11-16T09:40:48Z.

Pod events show the rollout and the start failure: Deployment product-catalog ScalingReplicaSet 09:37:18Z and 09:37:35Z, pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-wzpwm Killing and SuccessfulDelete at 09:37:27Z, and on product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l six Warning 'Failed' events (09:37:39Z-09:40:48Z) with the same runc "invalid-command" message plus 25 Warning BackOff events (09:37:40Z-09:42:50Z).

Service product-catalog (port 8080, selector opentelemetry.io/name=product-catalog) has no ready endpoint addresses: its Endpoints has empty addresses and only notReadyAddresses 100.96.2.148, whose targetRef is pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (the crash-looping pod).

product-catalog span rate collapsed from about 7.9-8.2 spans/s at 09:37:09Z to 1.02 at 09:39:09Z and 0 for every point from 09:41:09Z through 09:47:09Z, i.e. it stopped serving after its only pod was replaced; over the whole window its spans carry only status STATUS_CODE_UNSET (13952.38 increase, zero error-status spans), consistent with requests never reaching the server.

frontend's own error spans over the window are concentrated on the product-catalog and dependent paths: GET 3118.75, GET /api/products/{productId} 2451.2, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 2451.2, GET /api/recommendations 468.27, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 468.27, POST /api/checkout 312.69, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 312.79, POST 312.69, tcp.connect 17.32, while grpc AdService/GetAds, CartService/GetCart and CartService/AddItem are 0.

frontend error-span rate was 0 at every 2-minute point through 09:37:09Z, first became non-zero at evaluation 09:39:09Z (5.17 error spans/s over the preceding 120s) and stayed at 15.96-21.18 per second afterwards; its error share of its own spans was 57.18% at 09:47:00Z.

Every error span recorded by recommendation and checkout is on a product-catalog call or its enclosing operation: recommendation get_product_list 471.47 and /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts 471.47 (plus 3.06 on flagd EventStream), checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 292.27 and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 292.27; their error rates first became non-zero at 09:41:00Z.

frontend-proxy has its own error spans: ingress 3473.32 and router frontend egress 3460.08 over the window, with its error-span rate at 0 through 09:37:09Z and 8.03-10.47 per second from 09:39:09Z onward.

The frontend pod itself is not restarting or failing to start: pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running, ready=true, restartCount 0, no waiting reason - so the frontend error rate does not originate in the frontend container's own lifecycle.

Other services recorded no error spans in the window: accounting 0, currency 0, cart 0, shipping 0, quote 0, payment 0, email 0, fraud-detection 0, image-provider no error series; ad recorded only 2.05 error spans on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream out of 3461 total spans.

fraud-detection was considered as a cause because its pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-8bpr4 had an OOMKilled last termination (exitCode 137, finishedAt 2026-11-16T09:27:21Z, restartCount 1) inside the incident window, but fraud-detection recorded zero error spans and its only caller-facing errors observed (checkout) are product-catalog client calls starting 09:41:00Z, so this OOM is not tied to the frontend request-error alert.

The mechanism is connection-level failure of calls to product-catalog rather than application-level errors inside it: its Service has no ready endpoint, its own spans carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and the failures appear only on callers' client spans (frontend GetProduct, recommendation ListProducts, checkout GetProduct) and on caller tcp.connect spans - the specific gRPC status code (e.g. UNAVAILABLE) could not be read because no post-09:22Z traces and no container logs were available.

Remove the container command override (command: ["invalid-command"]) from the pod template of Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog so the image's default entrypoint runs again (equivalently roll back to the template of ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc), then confirm the Deployment reports available replicas and that Endpoints product-catalog lists a ready address.

Trace who applied the command change to the product-catalog Deployment around 09:37:18Z through the deployment source/manifest repository or cluster audit log; the change_history integration is not available in this Run, so the actor and method are unknown.

gaps: The alert's own PromQL expression could not be retrieved: list_prometheus_rules returned INVALID_PARAMS, so the annotation value 16.866 can not be reproduced; the observed frontend error share of its own spans at 09:47:00Z was 57.18% on a different basis.

kube-state-metrics series are absent from this Prometheus (get_metric_names for kube_.* and label owner_name over kube_replicaset_owner/kube_pod_owner returned no data), so Deployment/ReplicaSet/Pod availability over time is unknown; only current API objects were observed.

No container logs were obtainable: product-catalog pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l returned zero lines (its container never started) and frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 returned zero lines in 09:37:00Z-09:48:41Z, so application-level error text (e.g. gRPC UNAVAILABLE) could not be read.

Jaeger's retained traces for frontend end at source_end_at 2026-11-16T09:22:36Z, before the incident; the post-09:37 failure could therefore not be inspected span-by-span and gRPC status codes on the failing client calls are unknown.
The change_history integration is not integrated in this Run, so who changed the product-catalog Deployment command, and when in the manifest source, is unknown.
No latency comparison was attempted for this report; whether product-catalog latency changed before it became unavailable is unknown, and the alert concerns error rate only.
Pods for kafka, valkey-cart, postgresql, otel-collector and flagd were only seen in a pod listing; their application logs and error spans were not examined.
next_steps: Roll back or correct the otel-demo/product-catalog Deployment container command and verify the rollout reaches Available with a ready endpoint.
Confirm via manifest repository history or cluster audit logs who set command: ["invalid-command"] and whether the change was intended.
Re-check frontend, frontend-proxy, recommendation and checkout error rates after the product-catalog rollout stabilises to confirm the alert clears.
Separately investigate the fraud-detection OOMKill at 09:27:21Z (container memory limits vs. usage); it is not linked to this alert but is a real restart in the window.
